title: M21 — Break/fix 02: A Mutating Webhook That Never Fires
description: orders-api sits at 0/1 with no Pods, rejected by the validating webhook for a missing env label. But the author never sets env — the mutating webhook is supposed to. Its rules match UPDATE instead of CREATE, so it never fires on new Pods. The denial is at validation; the fault is upstream in mutation. Fix the mutating config's operations.
